answer: Each agent locks a 500-token bond and must answer one fresh challenge per epoch; rewards unlock only after it earns 5 pearls, the badges peers award for graded, original answers. A farm of 1,000 fakes ties up 500,000 tokens and must write 5,000 distinct texts first, and matching wording is a signal that forfeits every linked bond. Buying aged keys fails because a transfer resets the pearl count. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back on exit; its public history acts as a lantern for buyers choosing whom to trust.
